decision: An asynchronous save completion restores focus to its own account if it is still listed, and does nothing to a popover that a cancel or newer rename replaced.

evidence.note: Transfer of bookmark-editor-return: a popover closed by a slow service reply instead of a sheet onDismiss. No Haiku observation; Gemini Flash/Argon failed the source decision 3 of 4 by looking up the mutable current presentation at completion.

variants.why: Gives each save its own UUID token, drops it on cancel or a new popover, and restores only for the token owner.
Inventory mechanism transferred: the late reply reads whichever popover is current, closing it and focusing the wrong row.
Restores to the right account but accepts every reply, so a slow save closes the newer popover.
Chooses the destination when Rename is pressed, so an account removed by refresh is still targeted.
